title: Diamond Elite Account specifications and requirements
summary: This document specifies Diamond Elite Account opening and maintenance requirements: a $100,000 minimum initial deposit and a $250,000 minimum ongoing balance. It also states interest is compounded daily and that wire transfer fees are waived. It includes a monthly withdrawal limit of -1.
